import.for_each: ${{ for name, workspace in var.anthropic_workspaces : name => workspace if try(workspace.workspace_id, null) != null }}

anthropic_api_key_rotation_units.description: Imported Anthropic API key IDs and their existing 1Password rotation units
anthropic_api_key_rotation_units.value: ${{ for name, key in anthropic_api_key.managed : name => { api_key_id = key.id, vault_item_id = var.anthropic_api_keys[name].vault_item_id, vault_field = var.anthropic_api_keys[name].vault_field, vault_json_path = try(var.anthropic_api_keys[name].vault_json_path, null) } if var.anthropic_api_keys[name].status != "archived" }}

anthropic_workspace_ids.value: ${{ for name, workspace in anthropic_workspace.managed : name => workspace.id }}

anthropic_api_keys.description: Anthropic organization or workspace API keys
anthropic_api_keys.type: map(object({ api_key_id = string, name = string, status = string, vault_item_id = optional(string), vault_field = optional(string), vault_json_path = optional(string) }))

validation.condition: ${alltrue([for key in values(var.anthropic_api_keys) : contains(["active", "inactive", "archived"], key.status) && (key.status == "archived" ? key.vault_item_id == null && key.vault_field == null && key.vault_json_path == null : try(length(key.vault_item_id), 0) > 0 && try(length(key.vault_field), 0) > 0)])}
validation.error_message: Active and inactive keys require a vault rotation target; archived keys must retain only nonsecret metadata.

anthropic_workspace_members.type: map(object({ workspace_key = string, user_id = string, workspace_role = string }))

anthropic_workspaces.description: Anthropic workspaces to create and manage

tofu_state_encryption_passphrase.description: OpenTofu state and plan encryption passphrase from 1Password

validation.error_message: The OpenTofu state encryption passphrase must be at least 16 characters.
